summary:
Changing Protocol.md, eng/quint-qualification.json or the validator makes eng/quint-qualification-baseline.json stale (QQ-BASELINE-SOURCE/CONFIG and the physical-accounting validator binding) in every canonical-quint job, and the 19 counterexample manifests must carry the new source. Adding roots also requires a measurement row for each new root. A fresh complete measurement (the measure-only route, which skips only the baseline comparison) supplies the baseline; the validator and tests then re-pin to its identities. PR #1059 (FS-GG/.github#4820) admitted such a baseline: 289 logical = 289 physical calls, 9 roots and 19 formals, and the stable state/transition/sample counts of all 19 formals were identical to the historical baseline. Counterexample traces stay byte-identical; only each manifest's sourceSha256 and assembledQuintSha256 change.

The measure-only coverage guard compares journal files with the in-memory physical-attempt list. Until FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination#1064 the list was an unsynchronised ResizeArray appended from Parallel.ForEach (the 56 Rust mutation checks, degree 2), so a six-CPU attempt recorded 290 of 291 attempts and failed MEASUREMENT-PHYSICAL-COVERAGE while a one-CPU attempt did not lose a row. Parallel validation must record attempts through synchronised accounting; a pure control that appends from several workers while a reader enumerates fails on the unsynchronised list. Local measurement of unpublished source is ordinary verification under ADR-0096; it is calibration of the combined source and the owned compiler, not hosted qualification, and exact-head hosted CI and independent review remain required.

Failed attempts stay history: the six-CPU attempt is a retained failure, not a retried result. A hosted run can also fail intermittently in the unchanged Choreo C2 harness (FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination#1065); that is separate from baseline admission.
title: A canonical-model source change needs a fresh whole measurement, taken with synchronised attempt accounting
